newsitem.title: UK: London gold and silver close slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: London gold and silver close slightly firmer.

text.p: GOLD - Closes at $381.50/$382.00 vs $381.20/$381.70 on Tuesday. Eyeing silver for market direction. Trading in $380-$383 range. SILVER - Ends at $5.05/$5.07, up three cents after ticking slightly higher in afternoon. Resistance around $5.10. PLATINUM - Finishes unchanged at $385.00/$386.00. PALLADIUM - Closes unchanged at $116.00/$117.00, off day's lows. Market still seen bearish, with $115 as first target.
